items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I saw a Chinese fellow parked in his car waiting... the poor little guy, he's sitting in there shaking to death

ctx.x: Yes, there were American bands in the hotels. So, one morning after I came out, it must have been about 8 o'clock and we would ride the rik.shas, you know these .................... That's the first thing we did when we got to China was to get in a rik.sha and ride. These little guys pull them like horses. Snow, hot, it don't matter.

I was in a rik.sha coming home and I saw a Chinese fellow parked in his car waiting, he must have been waiting for somebody. After I'm around a building about ten Japanese ran up behind his car. They were doing maneuvers, right in the city, right in Shanghai these Japs, Japanese. They ran behind the car and pushed it like they were sneaking up on an enemy. And the poor little guy, he's sitting in there shaking to death, the little Chinese fellow.
